positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Soley designed and developed the frontend and backend for a dental compliance education ecommerce platform using existing course content
Integrated company LMS and CMS with the ability for content to be updated by non-technical users
Communicated directly with the CEO to manage project deadlines and ensure relevant stakeholders are satisfied
Automated migration of existing users for a seamless transition resulting in no downtime or lost revenue
Providing ongoing maintenance and technical support by diagnosing production issues and customer inquiries, maintaining an average incident resolution time of 4 hours

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led four member team in the creation of a multi-agent LLM application that integrates with Shopify to automate user’s workflows and conduct data analytics
Retrieval augmented generation capabilities using a Milvus vector database with fast chat history retrieval using Redis
Implemented CI/CD using GitOPs to deploy dockerized application with 99.95% availability
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language) , Leading Development Teams and +5 skills
